#### FoolsFest is a co-created campout filled with whimsy, comraderie and art in the great outdoors. After two very silly years, FoolsFest continues to evolve as a gathering of creative minds united in the spirit of mischief and playfulness, where strangers become collaborators and ordinary reality quietly loses its authority.

**Come help us build something foolish!**

**What: FoolsFest, a co-created campout**

**When: April 30-May 03, 2026**

**Where: [Live Oak Campground, Santa Barbara County, CA](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Live+Oak+Camp/@34.5543562,-119.8818684,15z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x80e9437d99e398fd:0x811c9e578a278160!8m2!3d34.5543562!4d-119.8818684!16s%2Fg%2F1tdftg1k?entry=ttu)**
